cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: SYN and client initial sequence number on first segment
acceptable_variants: SYN flag and client's initial sequence number
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 1) SYN / client initial sequence number on first segment (why: propose connection + starting seq)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (a) First segment (client → server): SYN flag and the client's initial sequence number (ISN).

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: SYN-ACK and server ISN + ack=client_ISN+1 on second segment
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: acknowledge client SYN and propose server seq
acceptable_variants: SYN and ACK flags, server's own ISN, and an acknowledgement number equal to client_ISN+1
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 2) SYN-ACK / server ISN + ack=client_ISN+1 on second segment (why: acknowledge client SYN and propose server seq)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (b) Second segment (server → client): SYN and ACK flags, the server's own ISN, and an acknowledgement number equal to client_ISN+1.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Final ACK / ack=server_ISN+1 on third segment
acceptable_variants: ACK flag with acknowledgement number equal to server_ISN+1
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 3) Final ACK / ack=server_ISN+1 on third segment (why: acknowledge server SYN; connection established)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (c) Third segment (client → server): ACK flag with acknowledgement number equal to server_ISN+1.

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: synchronize both ends / establish reliable connection before data transfer
acceptable_variants: purpose of the handshake is to synchronize both ends and establish a reliable connection
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 4) Purpose: synchronize both ends / establish reliable connection before data transfer
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: (d) Purpose: synchronize sequence numbers on both ends and establish a reliable full-duplex connection before data transfer.
